planned_implementation.rule: Do not edit original MinutePitAllocator or sealed source/PG/domain/TOM code. A thin extension must retain the exact original data/scaler/loss/sample/optimizer sequence, documenting any unavoidable fit-loop copy. Implementation needs separate GO.
planned_implementation.fit_loop_copy_contract: Keep original authority files unchanged. If the fit loop must be copied, bind its source SHA and preserve preparation, scalers, targets, auxiliary sampling and original combined-loss operation order. Append0.02*halfMSE only after L_original; do not inject it into allocation_objective or relabel allocation-loss diagnostics. Use the same primary encoder state, prevent auxiliary calls from overwriting that state, clear transient caches before model sealing, and retain one ordinary combined backward/globalclip2/AdamW step.

training.initialization: For each seed construct the original973-parameter network exactly, then append a zero-weight/zero-bias head without advancing the original RNG state. target_scaling.fit_rows: Exactly the same original3014 mature rows in source order for both targets
target_scaling.algorithm: For each S and Z compute float64 mean and sample std(ddof=1); standardize in float64 and cast once to float32. Constants shared by all3seeds; save constants and target hashes in Recorder. No evaluation fit/transform targets needed.
target_scaling.failure: Zero/nonfinite std or nonfinite standardized result stops; no partial cohort or altered formula.

training.loss: L_original +0.02*0.5*mean((new_scalar_head-standardized_target)**2), equal weighting over all3014primary rows.
training.original_loss: Unchanged H1 allocation objective, primaryH5 tail+alpha BCE coefficient0.02, auxiliary weighted tail+alpha BCE coefficient0.05, original10bp training proxy and0.006 turnover coefficient; all other spec/candidate settings inherited by exact saved model identities.
training.new_loss_path: Direct graph touches new head and shared encoder. At zero head initialization the first-step direct encoder gradient from new loss is0. New-head gradients still contribute to globalclip norm, so allocation-private updates can change; later representation and AdamW histories also differ. No shared-only/private-protected claim.
training.auxiliary_sampling: Original20741 rows/order/training_weight normalization, generator seed*1000+epoch, torch.randint with replacement, min(2048,20741) samples each of300epochs. B/C draw sequences identical. No S/Z supervision on auxiliary rows.
training.original_scalers: Recompute via original training-only path and require exact match to each pinned base_outer scaler and mechanical training tensors. All85original columns retained; model selects unchanged39primary/16common in original order.
training.optimizer: Exact original saved AdamW lr/weight_decay/all arguments, ordinary combined backward, one clip_grad_norm_(all parameters,max_norm=2.0), then one step per epoch. No per-task clipping, PG, detach, gradient normalization, extra steps or moment reset.
training.ensemble: Equal-weight all3seed predictions within each arm using the original aggregation path. No seed/checkpoint/arm selection; candidate is C only.
training.loss_trace: Persist all6 training traces and original/new loss components as diagnostics, not stop/selection/performance gates. Save final model/spec/scalers/target stats/optimizer state and attempt identity.
